0.name: Stable Market
0.description: Normal market conditions - baseline for learning
hints: 📊 GLOBAL OUTLOOK: GDP chugging along at 2.4% YoY - services sector leading the charge
💰 PRICES & WAGES: Inflation anchored at 2.0%, energy markets flat, wage pressures cooling off
🏦 CENTRAL BANKS: Policy rates on hold across major economies; 'wait and see' mode continues
🏭 MANUFACTURING: PMI at 52.0 - modest expansion, inventories back to normal levels
📈 MARKET MOOD: Steady as she goes - no fireworks, no panic, just business as usual

econBrief.rates: Policy on hold; credit spreads tight

1.name: Asia Boom
1.description: Strong economic growth in Asia drives demand surge
hints: 🚀 ASIA ON FIRE: Regional GDP roaring at 6.2% YoY - infrastructure boom meets services explosion!
📦 EXPORT SURGE: Asia exports up 9% YoY, PMI hits 54.5 - factories can't keep up with orders
🏙️ URBANIZATION WAVE: Middle class expanding rapidly in India, Vietnam, Indonesia - consumption soaring
💳 CONSUMER CONFIDENCE: Household spending accelerating, credit growth +8%, sentiment at 3-year high
🌏 SPILLOVER EFFECTS: US seeing modest tech/luxury demand bump (+3%) from wealthy Asian buyers
⚠️ EUROPE WATCH: Slight demand softness (-5%) as global capital flows East, Euro remains under pressure

2.name: Green Wave
hints: 🌱 CLIMATE PACT SIGNED: 47 nations commit to carbon neutrality - green subsidies flowing freely
📋 ESG CRACKDOWN: EU/UK tightening disclosure rules, carbon border taxes coming in 2027
💚 CONSUMER SHIFT: Major survey shows 62% willing to pay 10-15% premium for sustainable products
🏆 BRAND WINS: Companies with strong ESG scores seeing +18% brand loyalty vs. laggards
⚡ RENEWABLES BOOM: Solar/wind costs plummeting - green energy now cheaper than fossil in most markets
💸 PREMIUM PRICES STICK: Low elasticity - eco-conscious buyers less price-sensitive, more values-driven
🇪🇺 EUROPE LEADS: +10% demand surge for green products, US +5% following, Asia watching closely

3.name: Price War
3.description: Economic slowdown makes consumers highly price-conscious
hints: 📉 GROWTH STALLS: Global GDP decelerates to 0.9% YoY - economists warn of 'soft patch' ahead
🏪 RETAIL BLOODBATH: Major chains launch aggressive discounts - 'Black Friday every day' mentality
💰 BARGAIN HUNTERS: Consumers trading down across categories - private label sales up 22%
📊 INVENTORY GLUT: Warehouses 15% above normal - retailers desperate to clear excess stock
😰 CONFIDENCE CRASH: Consumer sentiment indexes at 18-month lows across all regions
🌍 REGIONAL PAIN: Europe hit hardest (-15%), US struggling (-10%), even resilient Asia down -5%
🎯 PRICE WARS: Every dollar counts - elasticity surges 40% as shoppers become ruthlessly price-focused

4.name: Recession
4.description: Broad demand pullback as consumers delay purchases
hints: 🚨 RECESSION DECLARED: Global GDP contracts 1.1% YoY - first negative print since 2020
📈 UNEMPLOYMENT RISES: Jobless claims surge, hiring freezes widespread across industries
🏦 CREDIT CRUNCH: Banks tightening lending standards, consumer credit card defaults up 30%
🛒 SPENDING COLLAPSE: Discretionary purchases postponed - only essentials moving off shelves
📦 INVENTORY NIGHTMARE: Retailers stuck with 25% excess stock, markdowns accelerating
😱 SENTIMENT PLUNGE: Consumer confidence at decade lows - 'wait and see' mentality prevails
🌐 GLOBAL CONTAGION: Europe -15%, US -12%, Asia -8% - no safe haven markets
💸 DESPERATE BUYERS: Price sensitivity through the roof (+50%) - even loyal customers defecting for deals

5.name: Trade War
5.description: Tariffs and restrictions disrupt global supply chains
hints: 🛃 TARIFF SHOCK: New 12% duties on US-Asia trade, 6% on US-Europe routes - protectionism rising
📦 SUPPLY CHAOS: Cross-border shipping delays up 40%, customs backlogs at major ports
💵 COST PRESSURES: Procurement costs jump 7% on imported goods, margins under siege
🏭 RESHORING BUZZ: 'Buy local' sentiment surging - domestic manufacturing gets political boost
⚠️ RETALIATION FEARS: Markets volatile as countries threaten counter-tariffs - uncertainty paralyzing investment
📉 DEMAND HIT: Asia -10%, Europe -6%, US -5% as trade friction dampens global commerce
🌐 FRAGMENTATION: Supply chains fragmenting into regional blocs - globalization in reverse

6.name: Pandemic Shock
6.description: Demand weakens amid mobility and supply disruptions
hints: 🦠 OUTBREAK SPREADS: New variant triggers mobility restrictions in 30+ countries
🚫 LOCKDOWN LITE: Retail foot traffic down 45%, malls and stores operating at limited capacity
🚢 SUPPLY MELTDOWN: Port closures extend lead times by 3-4 weeks, freight costs up 60%
🏠 STAY-AT-HOME: Consumers shift spending to essentials, savings rates spike to 12%
💳 DISCRETIONARY FREEZE: Non-essential purchases postponed indefinitely - travel, dining, retail crushed
📉 GLOBAL SLOWDOWN: GDP -0.6% YoY, Asia hit hardest at -12%, US -8%, Europe -10%
🌡️ UNCERTAINTY PREMIUM: Businesses delay investment, consumers hoard cash 'just in case'
💰 PARADOX: High price sensitivity (+30%) despite low inflation - fear drives frugality

7.name: Regional Conflict
7.description: Geopolitical shock hits Europe demand and logistics
hints: ⚔️ CONFLICT ERUPTS: Eastern European tensions escalate into military confrontation
⚡ ENERGY CRISIS: Natural gas prices triple, electricity costs surge across EU
😰 EUROPEAN PANIC: Consumer confidence collapses, GDP contracts 2.0% YoY - worst since 2009
🚢 SHIPPING CHAOS: Black Sea routes closed, Baltic traffic rerouted - delivery times +50%
💶 EURO WEAKNESS: Currency down 12% vs USD as capital flees to safety
🛡️ DEFENSE SPENDING: Government budgets shift to military - infrastructure projects delayed
🌍 SPILLOVER: US -4%, Asia -3% as European import demand evaporates (-20%)
📦 LOGISTICS PREMIUM: Tariff-like costs hit routes to Europe - 9% from Asia, 5% from US

8.name: AI Productivity Boom
8.description: Automation lifts output and consumer purchasing power
hints: 🤖 AI REVOLUTION: Productivity gains accelerate to 4.2% annually - fastest since 1990s tech boom
💼 WAGE GROWTH: Real incomes up 3.8% as workers share in efficiency gains - purchasing power surges
🏭 COST COLLAPSE: Business operating costs down 3% as automation spreads - margins expanding
📈 CAPEX BOOM: Business investment up 12% YoY - companies racing to deploy AI infrastructure
🛍️ SPENDING SPREE: Discretionary demand expands across all regions - US +6%, Asia +8%, Europe +5%
💚 VALUES MATTER: Prosperous consumers increasingly focused on ethics, quality, sustainability (+10% CSR importance)
💰 PRICING POWER: Lower price sensitivity as rising incomes make consumers less deal-focused
🌐 VIRTUOUS CYCLE: Growth feeds growth - GDP at 3.2% YoY with inflation contained at 1.6%

9.name: Energy Shock
9.description: Energy costs surge, squeezing consumer budgets
hints: ⛽ OIL SPIKE: Crude prices jump to $125/barrel - geopolitical tensions choke supply
💡 UTILITY BILLS SOAR: Electricity and heating costs up 35%, gasoline +40% at the pump
📉 DISCRETIONARY CUTS: Households slash non-essential spending to cover energy bills
🏭 MARGIN SQUEEZE: Manufacturing costs surge 12% - freight, utilities, inputs all climbing
🚚 LOGISTICS PREMIUM: Shipping costs mirror oil price - effective 8% tariff on all trade routes
😰 CONSUMER STRESS: Real incomes falling as inflation hits 3.8% - budgets stretched thin
🌍 UNEQUAL IMPACT: Europe -8% (gas dependent), Asia -5%, US -4% (domestic energy helps)
💸 PRICE WARS: Elasticity spikes 25% as every purchase becomes a careful calculation

10.name: Recovery Rally
10.description: Broad-based rebound lifts demand across all regions
hints: 🎉 RECOVERY MODE: Global GDP accelerates to 3.0% YoY - synchronized expansion across continents
📈 CONFIDENCE RETURNS: Consumer sentiment indexes at 2-year highs - 'animal spirits' awakening
🚢 SUPPLY CHAINS HEAL: Lead times normalize, port congestion clears, freight rates stabilizing
💰 SPENDING UNLEASHED: Pent-up demand released - discretionary purchases surge across categories
🌍 BROAD-BASED: All regions participating - US +8%, Asia +10%, Europe +7% demand gains
🏦 POLICY SUPPORT: Central banks maintaining accommodative stance, governments offering tax relief (-1%)
💳 SMART SPENDING: Moderate price sensitivity as consumers feel secure but remain value-conscious
📊 GOLDILOCKS: PMI at 54.0 - strong but not overheating, inflation contained at 2.1%
